spans.s: Daurmukhi, a Pāṇḍava warrior. § 600 (Ghaṭotkacavadhap.): VII, 158, 7008 (Janamejayaḥ?).--§ 601 (Droṇavadhap.): VII, 184, 8366.

Dauryodhana, adj. (“belonging to Duryodhana”). § 552 (Goharaṇap.): IV, 55, 1712 (bale).--§ 591 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 17, 720 (sainyaṃ).--§ 592 (do.): VII, 18, 744 (balaṃ), 749 (sainyaṃ).--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 93, 4864 (balaṃ).--§ 611 (Śalyap.): IX, 16, 860 (sainyaṃ).-§ 785 (Anugītāp.): XIV, 60, 1791 (bale).
Dauryodhani, patron. (“son of Duryodhana”) = Lakshmaṇa: VI, 2367.
